Commentary.Commentary: Update 1750 local - We've received an update from the Cricket Australia twitter handle that if there is no more rain stoppage, the chase will get underway in five minutes time. Let's hope for the best.
Update 1745 local - Not a pleasant sight, folks. The covers are on as it's drizzling at the moment. It appears that we are in for a delayed start. Stay tuned for more updates...

231 needed for India to pocket the series and cap a wonderful Australian tour. 10 wickets required for Australia to try and earn their first ODI series win since January 2017, in their 6th attempt. Just a reminder - even though the innings has ended early, we will still have only a 30-minute break. Join us back soon.

The leggie continued to run through the Aussie line-up, picking up his best ever ODI figures. Peter Handscomb batted sensibly, fought hard, almost till the end and took Australia to 230. Only three bowlers got wickets for India but apart from Kedar Jadhav and Ravindra Jadeja, everyone bowled well.

After being put in to bat under murky conditions, the hosts were reduced to 27/2 before some repair work was done by Usman Khawaja and Shaun Marsh. However, Chahal's twin strike in the first over pegged Oz back and they could barely muster any recovery from there.

Well, Australia have got some sort of a score on board. It is by no means match-winning but with overcast conditions, some juice in the wicket, they can make it look competitive. They have struggled with the bat, no doubt, but the middle order has given some respectability to the total, yet again.

OUT! Bowled 'em! AUSTRALIA HAVE BEEN BOWLED OUT FOR 230! Shami wrapping things up nicely. Keeps it full, straight and has some pace on it, comes in a bit too and that takes Stanlake. It goes past the inside edge of his hanging bat, deflects off the back pad and crashes into the stumps.
Angles it across from a bit of a fullish length, around off, Stanlake hangs his bat out and gets beaten on the outside.
Too straight in line, turned away into the leg side for a single.
Length delivery outside off, Siddle fails to put bat on ball.

The googly on middle and leg, worked away on the leg side for a single. An excellent outing for Yuzvendra Chahal. He finishes with figures of 10-0-42-6, which are the joint-best for a visiting bowler in ODIs.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Billy Stanlake comes out to bat now.

OUT! First-ever 6-wicket haul for Yuzvendra Chahal in ODI cricket. A typical tailender's shot from Adam Zampa. Seeing the flight on the ball, he jumps out and looks to go big downtown. Can only manage to sky it towards long on where Vijay Shankar settles under it and takes a safe catch.
Quick, short and flat outside off, Zampa ends up chopping it off the bottom edge on the off side.
Siddle steps out and hits it from the inner half through mid-wicket. A single is collected.
Full in line of the stumps, pushed straight back down the track.
Cuts back in off the surface, Siddle works it to mid-wicket with soft hands and rushes through to the other end.
Length ball on off stump, blocked from inside the crease.
FOUR! Nicely done. Extremely full just outside off, Siddle gets low, opens the face of the bat and squeezes it fine through the vacant slip cordon. A useful boundary results.

Run out chance missed! Siddle pats this wide of cover and takes off. Rohit swiftly moves across to his left, collects and fires a throw at the striker's end. Misses by a small margin, Zampa will feel lucky for that.
Short ball banged in, ducked and evaded by Siddle.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. One run added to the total.
Peter Siddle is in next.

OUT! Second 5-fer for Yuzvendra Chahal. Absolutely well-deserved. He becomes the third Indian to take an ODI 5-fer in Australia, second one at the MCG after Ajit Agarkar. Bowls it quicker through the air and it keeps a little low too, comes in with the angle and catches Peter Handscomb low on the pads as he goes back to work it across the line. A loud shout goes up and so does the finger. Handscomb takes the DRS and it goes upstairs. Replays show he's gone for all money. A very sensible knock from him under pressure.
Review time. Taken out of desperation more than anything. Peter Handscomb is the man in question as he's been adjudged lbw.
The batsman has driven it through mid on. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and straight from the bowler, Zampa hits it straight back down the track.
Another mistimed shot and it's fallen safely yet again. Slower through the air, just behind a driving length outside off, Zampa lofts it over covers and take two.
Tossed up outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
Flighted leg break around off, Zampa pushes it on the off side by opening his body up.
Zampa moves inside the line and works it through to deep mid-wicket for a run.

In the air but it's safe! Handscomb camps back to this back of a length ball and heaves it over mid-wicket. The slow outfield stops the ball from going to the rope, but it's enough to fetch the batsmen three good runs.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Good length ball outside off, dabbed wide of point and the batsmen take one more.
A hint of reverse for Bhuvi, Handscomb picks it off his pads and flicks it through mid-wicket for a brace.
Fraction straight in line, worked off the pads behind square leg for a single.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar is back on.
The wrong 'un on middle and leg, spinning in, Zampa turns it away on the leg side for a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Full ball attacking the stumps, Zampa prods forward and defends.
Adam Zampa is the new man in.

OUT! Chahal strikes again, bags his 4th of the innings. A rather soft dismissal though, Richardson will be a bit disappointed with that. Handy partnership of 45 is brought to a close. Quite slow through the air, on middle and leg, Richardson is too early into the flick shot. He chips it towards short mid-wicket where Kedar Jadhav takes an easy tumbling catch moving to his left.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Floated delivery on the stumps, driven towards wide mid on for a single.
Nicely time and superbly placed again. Richardson drives this full delivery through the big gap in the covers and comes back for the second.

FOUR! That's a well-placed shot. Richardson rocks back to this short ball and pulls it through backward square leg. Rayudu (sub) from square leg rushes to his right, tries to slide but his left leg gets caught in the ground and his ankle twists. Still tries to save the boundary but his body is touching the rope while trying to get the ball away. He's off the field for now, hope it's nothing serious. Also, with this, Australia cross the 200-mark.
On a length, in line of the stumps, it's punched down to long on for a run.
Fuller length ball outside off, patted wide of point for a quick single.
In the channel outside off, Jhye looks to run it down to third man late but mistimes it back down the track.
Good length delivery outside off, a play and a miss from the batter.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have run through for a single.

Fifty for Peter Handscomb, 3rd in this format and two of them have come in this series itself. This is a good knock from him. Doing well when the chips have been down. Short ball on off, Handscomb works it to long on and gets to the other end.
Uses the depth of the crease to go back and nudges it down to fine leg for a run.
Short and flat, outside off, punched right to the point fielder.
Looped up leg break on off stump, worked in front of square on the leg side for a single.
Quicker, shorter and around off, Peter goes back and mistimes the punch back to the bowler.
Yuzvendra Chahal returns to the attack.
Plays this very late. Handscomb waits for the ball to come to him before cutting it down to third man for one run.
Short ball on off stump, Richardson drags the pull along the turf, in front of square leg, for an easy run.
Length ball aiming the top of off stump, blocked with a slightly opened face.
Full delivery attacking the stumps, driven towards the mid on area for a single.
On a length around off, tapped down beside the track on the off side.
Fuller length ball around off, skidding off the deck, Handscomb defends it down in front of cover-point.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. A maximum of 5 fielders will be allowed outside the ring till the end of the innings.

Gets across and pushes this down the ground towards long on for a run. So 160/4 in 40 overs of Powerplay 2 for Australia which is not bad but they have no batting left to try and get 70-plus runs from here on.
Landed outside off, on a length, PH looks to run it down to third man but gets a bottom edge which goes past the stumps.
WIDE. Slower ball, fuller in length, but it is miles outside off. Left alone.
Another short ball, this is pulled with a bit more power, in front of square on the leg side, for a couple.

FOUR! Calculated risk from Handscomb. He spots that mid on is in the circle and so is mid-wicket. Gets the length he wants, which is in between short and full. But does not go with hard hands. Plays a controlled chip over mid-wicket. The ball rolls slowly after bouncing but still makes it to the ropes. Peter moves to 43 from 47 balls.
An appeal for LBW but nothing in it. On a length outside off, Handscomb got well across his stumps to flick but missed and was hit on the pads. Impact outside off, missing the stumps as well.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Outside off, Richardson feels for it but misses.
Played to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Eases this down the ground but finds mid on who is very straight.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around middle, Handscomb looks to defend but is beaten by the late inward movement. Gets a thick inside edge onto the pads, which rolls back to the bowler.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar returns. 5-1-15-2 so far.
Outside off, steered towards third man for a run. Ordinary over from Shankar, but Australia are crippled. Cannot go for strokes because no batting left, right...
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. One run added to the total.
Around off, tight line, watchfully defended.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Full and just outside off, watchfully defended.
Full and wide outside off, Handscomb steers it uppishly towards third man for a single.
Vijay Shankar is brought back. 4-0-12-0 so far.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers this time, for a brace.
Full and outside off, Jhye looks to drive but misses.
Outside off, Handscomb waits for the ball to come to him and steers it late to third man for a run.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a single.
A short ball, around off, Handscomb gets across and pulls it all across the turf, through square leg for a single.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Another fortuitous shot. Outside off, Handscomb looks to punch it through the off side but gets a thick outside edge which flies past slip towards third man.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Ravindra Jadeja back on.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. They pick up a single.
DRINKS BREAK. This might be over quickly now. Jhye Richardson is the new man in.

OUT! Caught this time! Maxwell's luck runs out. A short ball, right at the body, Maxi looks to pull but gets a top edge. For a second, it seems like the ball will not carry to fine leg. But Bhuvneshwar Kumar comes running in, keeps his eyes on the ball and then dives to take a fantastic catch. That ends the stay of the last recognized batting pair for Australia. Into the bowlers now.
WIDE. A bouncer too high, Glenn lets it go.

TOP EDGE, FOUR! Maxwell and Handscomb flirting with their luck. A sharp bouncer, around middle, Maxi swivels, looks to pull but is hurried into the shot. The top edge flies over the keeper to the fine leg fence.
Full and straight, watchfully defended.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Outside off, played through point for a couple.
A change in pace finally. Mohammed Shami returns. 5-0-14-0 so far.
FOUR! MAGNIFICENT! Full and wide outside off, Maxwell reaches out and drives it through the covers for a boundary! 11 from the over.
Jumps down the track and eases it towards long on for one.
Full on middle, eased past the bowler towards long on for a run.
Around off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! A full toss, Maxwell takes full toll and swipes it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
A short ball, around off, Handscomb chips it in the air and just clears a leaping short mid-wicket. A single taken.
Outside off, punched through the covers for a run.
Full and around off, driven back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
FOUR! BOSH! A long hop, right in the middle of the pitch, Maxwell rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Outside off, steered down to third man for a single.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
FOUR! Short and outside off, Maxwell rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!

LEADING EDGE, SAFE! Slice of luck for Peter Handscomb. A wicket here and India can finish this innings off in a matter of minutes. Full on middle, Peter comes down the track and looks to swing across the line. But gets a top edge which goes high in the air. The bowler and short mid-wicket run back, the latter dives but cannot reach the ball. A single taken.
Full on middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Simple piece of fielding but in shambles. Maxwell drives this straight back but Chahal cannot stop it. A single taken.
Full on middle, pushed towards long on for a single.
Darted full and fast on off, Glenn Maxwell blocks it out safely.
Handscomb finds long on once more, with a sweet drive this time. One more run to the total.
Full in length, well outside off, driven through the covers. A run is collected.
Fraction straight in line, allows Peter to move inside the line and wrist it to long on for one.
Leans into the drive and caresses it through the covers for a single.
Loopy and full, around the off stump, Maxwell blocks it out by coming forward.
Nice flight on this, full on off, Handscomb digs it out to the right of the bowler.
Off the mark without wasting much time. Maxwell drives it off the front foot to long off and changes ends.
Tossed up on off stump, Maxwell is well forward in defense.
Two slips in place now.
Glenn Maxwell strides out to the middle now.

OUT! Chahal bags his third. This is sensational bowling. And well caught by Rohit Sharma too. The leggie slows this up just a bit as he floats it on middle and leg, it turns away slightly and takes the outside edge as Stoinis is squared up while defending. It goes behind, where Sharma dives to his right and takes a one-handed catch just inches above the turf.
Handscomb goes straight, works it towards long on and gets a run.
Turning away from outside off, dabbed with an open face to point.
This full ball is pushed away wide of the man at mid on. Single taken.

Edged but safe! Landing on off and going away, Stoinis is squared up a bit as he defends and gets an edge. It flies past Rohit at first slip and runs down to third man. Shami chases after it and keeps the batsmen to three.
Quicker through the air, shorter in length around off. Stoinis hangs back and defends it on the off side.
To the same fielder again, off the front foot this time though. Handscomb drives it to sweeper cover and jogs across to the other end.
Short, flat and outside off, cracked off the back foot through to sweeper cover. One more run to the total.
Full delivery well outside off, Handscomb drives it square through point and takes a single as the man in the deep mops it up.
Full on off, met with the full face of the bat to end the over.
Drifting in at first but then spins away, on a driving length around off. Stoinis makes a good leave.
Spinning away from off stump, Stoinis slightly opens the bat face and defends.
Keeps his eyes on the ball as he comes half-forward and blocks it well.
FOUR! Good shot. Goes straight and finds the boundary. Stoinis hits this flighted delivery past Jadeja at mid on and sends it across the boundary line.
Handscomb makes good use of the feet. Steps out to this one and whips it towards wide mid on. Takes off for the run, Jadeja fires a throw in at the bowler's end but it hits the batsman instead.
Minimal turn for Jadeja, around off, Stoinis blocks by going deep inside the crease.
Quicker one on off, punched defensively to the covers.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Stoinis comes ahead to this one and drives it with hard hands to mid off.
Pushed quicker through the air, outside the line of off stump, no shot offered.
Full delivery on off, drilled to long off for one run.
Tossed up delivery around off, on a driving length, watchfully left alone by the all-rounder.
Sprays this on the pads, Peter Handscomb easily tucks it behind square leg and crosses over.
Landed outside off and it goes away, cut away square on the off side. Single taken.
Looped up leg break outside off, eased down the ground to long off again and one more run is collected.
A bump ball from Stoinis. He comes forward and drives it to the left of a diving Chahal to long off and gets to the other end.
A bit slower through the air, not much turn on this occasion though, Marcus defends it with a straight bat.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Full and outside off, quicker in pace, Peter opens his body up and drives it straight to point.
Plants his front foot forward and smacks it through the gap in the covers for a double.
Going away again, around off, the batsman presses forward and blocks it out.
Spinning away from around off, touch shorter in length, Handscomb hangs his bat out to dry and almost edges it behind.
Darts it full and flat on middle and leg, Handscomb flicks it through mid-wicket and comes back for the second.
The leg break, landed short in length on off, Stoinis hangs back and blocks it out. A successful over from Chahal comes to an end.
The googly on middle, turns in, goes off Stoinis' pads as he misses his flick shot.
Marcus Stoinis to bat next.

OUT! Double strike for the leggie Chahal. What an over. He's sent the two set batsmen back in the dressing room in quick succession. This isn't a great ball to be honest, short and flat on the stumps. Khawaja goes back to work it across the line but the ball pops up off the leading edge. Hands a simple catch to Chahal who accepts it with a smile.
Handscomb comes down the track and hits it to long off for a single.
Quicker one on the stumps, kept out off the back foot.
Peter Handscomb walks into the middle next.

OUT! This is a big wicket for the visitors. Marsh has been sublime in this series and this pair has been the most successful for the Aussies. Partnership of 73 comes to an end. Shaun had 50-plus scores in his last three innings, first time he's failed to get to the mark. Chahal bowls this down the leg side as Marsh gives the charge, fails to put bat on ball and that's his undoing right there, because MS Dhoni is behind the stumps and he's lightning with the gloves. He whips the bails off in a flash and the square leg umpire takes it upstairs. Replays show Marsh is out of here. Wide ball signalled as well.
A stumping appeal is referred upstairs. Shaun Marsh is the man in question.
Floats it up there, around off, Marsh defends well.
Yuzvendra Chahal to roll his arm over.
Leans ahead to this fullish length ball and knocks it to long on to keep strike.
Usman moves inside the line and helps it down towards fine leg for one.
Some flight on this, close to off, blocked.
FOUR! Unfurls the same shot and gets the desired result. Good placement from the batsman. On leg stump, Khawaja places the reverse sweep through cover-point and sends it across the boundary line.
Fuller in line of the stumps, Usman brings out the reverse sweep and plays it on the off side.
Too straight in line, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Wide! Jadeja comes from around the wicket and spins in on leg, goes down as the batsman misses his flick. Wide called.
Spinning away from around off, Marsh covers the line and lets it through.
Stays on the back foot and keeps it out safely.
Coming in on off stump, Khawaja backs away and forces the punch through the covers. Single to the total.
Uses the angle into him as he works this in front of square leg for one run.
Drifting in from around off, Marsh positions himself behind the line and blocks it out.
Short and wide outside off, cut behind square on the off side for a couple of runs. Deep point moves to his right and mops it up.
The batsman has nudged the ball fine down the leg side. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Worked away into the leg side with the turn for a single.
Wide! Down the leg side, wide signalled on this occasion.
Was there an edge? Seems like there was. Interesting. Down leg, Khawaja looks to play the reverse sweep but the ball takes the under edge and goes past the keeper. Two taken.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Too straight in line, worked to the man at mid-wicket.
Spinning in on middle and leg, flicked away through mid-wicket for a brace.
Landed outside off, Khawaja looks to cut but gets an outside edge which flies past short third man. Two runs taken. 15 from the over. A loosening of the grip feeling for the Aussies.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Another bad ball. Short again and Marsh pounces. Rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary! Second of the over. 50-run stand comes up, third in a row between this pair.
Full and outside off, eased through the covers for a run.
Another short ball, Marsh goes off side this time. Punches it through the covers. Three runs taken, thanks to the large boundaries at the MCG.
FOUR! BOOM! First time an adjective has been used today. A real bad ball, half-tracker, Marsh rocks back and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary!
Full and around middle, Shaun comes down the track and flicks it through square leg for a single.
WIDE. Another one down the leg side, SOS bails out of the pull at the last moment.
Gets right behind the line and blocks.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads as he tries to tuck it through the leg side.
WIDE. Down the leg side, flick shot missed.
Same shot, a little further than Kohli this time, straight to deep backward square leg. Just a single.
Down the leg side, Khawaja tucks it extremely fine and beats Virat Kohli at leg slip towards fine leg. Two runs taken.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Spin from both ends. Ravindra Jadeja to bowl now.

Superb ball. Full and outside off, Shaun lunges to defend but is beaten by the away turn and bounce. Dhoni looks to take the bails off but misses. The ball deflects onto the stumps and Jadhav, along with Kohli, asks the square leg umpire regarding the stumping but it is deferred. Probably Marsh was back in.
TOP EDGE, SAFE! Lucky, is Khawaja. Full and outside off, Usman gets down to sweep but gets a top edge due to the extra bounce, which lands safely near square leg. A single taken.
Short and outside off, cut straight to point.
Another short ball. SOS goes back and lashes out a fierce pull but Rohit Sharma at short mid-wicket dives and takes some sting off the ball. Two runs taken as the ball deflects towards wide long on.
A long hop but it barely bounces. Khawaja goes back to pull but mistimes it past the bowler through mid on. A run taken.
A short ball outside off, Marsh goes back and cuts it through point for a single.
A length ball on middle, turned straight to short mid-wicket.
Down the leg side, Shaun misses his tuck and is hit on the pads. A leg bye taken.
Back to tight lines, SOS is back defending.

FOUR! 59. Vijay Shankar's jersey number in ODIs. 59. Balls after which a boundary has been scored. A rare loose ball from Shankar, or from India for that matter. It is a short ball. Imagine those days when your stomach is upset and you are allowed nothing to eat, except fruits. Then someone offers you a tasty barbecue. So, a normal human being would throw caution to the wind and pounce on that offer. Marsh does the same. Rocks back and pulls it without any second thought over mid-wicket.
Stays back in his crease and defends.
Down the leg side, helped through square leg for a single.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
Outside off, Marsh looks to cut but gets a bottom edge.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

WAS THAT A DROP? Looking at Kedar and Dhoni's reactions, you would feel it is. Looking at Marsh's reaction, you would not feel anything. Yes. SNICKOMETER CONFIRMS. A nothing ball from Jadhav, just landing it outside off. A nothing shot from Marsh, attempting to push it away to the off side without bothering to move his feet. Gets a thin outside edge which goes right into the mitts of Dhoni but he is not able to take it and deflects it onto the stumps. Frustrated, is Dhoni.
Down the leg side, Marsh helps it behind short fine leg and gets a couple.

No idea about this one. Absolutely did not pick it at all, did Marsh. He was backing away to the leg side, probably aiming to run this down to third man. But the slower one from Shankar foxed him and he was months early into that shot. Got an inside edge which went towards the leg side and a single was eked out.
Well bowled. Tight, in line of the stumps, SOS can only block.
On a good length, around middle, Marsh looks to tuck but misses and is hit on the pads.
Straighter from Vijay, this time Khawaja waits for the ball to come and dabs it late towards third man for a run.
Full and outside off, driven straight to point.
Short and around off, Marsh is straightaway onto the pull. Mistimes it as the ball does not come onto the bat as much as he would have liked. Skews it through mid-wicket and gets a single.
Around middle, pushed down to long on for one more.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Finally reads. Connects his drive and finds the gap through the covers for a single.
Another under-cutter from Jadhav, SM is not able to pick it at all and pushes it towards point at the last moment. Wants a single but is quickly sent back.
This is outside off, TURNS AWAY, Shaun comes forward to defend but is comprehensively beaten. Dhoni whips the bails off but SOS is back by that time.
Slow, slower, slowest from Kedar, around middle, with the arm going lower and lower, Marsh is barely able to see and blocks it at the last moment.

That was close. That was plumb. But it is not out. Because of wood. Full and straight, Usman played all around it, looking to flick but missed it. Was hit on the pads and Shankar was all set to appeal but quickly realized the inside edge.
Outside off, steered towards third man for one.
Full and straight, pushed back to the bowler.
Slowly bowled, around off, Marsh waits and waits and waits for the slow coach to arrive and when it finally does, dabs it tentatively towards point.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
On a length around off, steep bounce, Khawaja plays that nicely, getting on top of the bounce and punching it towards point.
Full and outside off again, eased through the covers for one more.
Full and outside off, driven straight to sweeper cover for another single.
Outside off, Usman looks to cut but is cramped for room. Gets a bottom edge wide of point and scampers through for one.
Too full outside off, squeezed through the covers for a run.
A short ball around off, Khawaja goes back and pulls it towards long on for a single.
The batsman works it down the leg side.
Spin time. Kedar Jadhav to bowl.
Short and outside off, Shaun cuts it towards point where Ravindra Jadeja dives to his left and stops it. Not a bad start from the debutant.
Back to bowling tight lines, around off, pushed towards point.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Marsh misses his tuck.
Gets right behind the line and blocks.
On a good length around middle, Marsh gets across to tuck but misses and is hit on the pads.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Full and around middle, Khawaja tucks it wide of mid on and gets a single.

POWERPLAY 2 time. 4 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle, till the 40th over. But, will Kohli want men outside the ring? Here comes the debutant, VIJAY SHANKAR. Nice time to bowl as well, with the batsmen thinking about survival more than getting after you.
Rising off the deck, from a length and outside off, Marsh raises his bat skywards and leaves it alone.
Switches to over the wicket and pitches this full, targets the off stick, Marsh brings down a straight bat in defense.
Too far outside off, the batsman has nothing to do with it.
Short of a good length outside off, cut away square on the off side for a couple of runs.
Outside off on a good length, left alone for the keeper to collect.
Coming in from around the wicket, fullish in length, Khawaja runs it down to third man for a single.
Shaun Marsh is the new man in.

OUT! GONE! Bhuvi finally gets the better of Finch. It was an interesting duel between the two, but it's the Indian who comes out victorious. He got out to similar deliveries in the previous two matches, is dismissed in a similar manner now as well. This is the joint-most times (3) Bhuvneshwar has dismissed a batsman in an ODI series. He brings it back in and it keeps a little low too, Finch tries to defend but is struck flush on the front pad in front of the stumps. He consults with Khawaja about whether he should take the DRS or not, decides not to opt for it in the end.
Bhuvneshwar is a little upset here. He released the ball when he reached the umpire and not the usual landing crease, so this put Finch off and he backed out. The bowler doesn't like this at all.
Well outside the crease once more, so Finch is able to play this early. Deals with the length ball well as he defends it in front of cover.
A good, positive drive again but straight to mid off once more. Finch slowly seems to be finding his groove as he middles this well. Aggressive intent, nice to see.
Quite far outside off, no chance the batsman bothers himself with it.
A little too full this time, around off, Finch drives but finds Dhawan at mid off.
Fuller length delivery outside off, met with a straight blade in defense.
Immense swing for Shami. Comes in at first and then goes away as it passes the batsman. It was on a length outside off and Usman just let it go.
On the fuller side of things, outside off, driven hard but can't get it wide of the man at cover.
Shami comes from around the wicket and hurls it outside off, Khawaja tries to smash this through the off side but fails to connect.
Some room on offer outside off, cut away hard but straight to the fielder at point.
Targets the top of off stump, blocked down with soft hands on the off side.

Full delivery outside off, Usman plants his front foot forward and drives it on the up through extra cover. Chahal chases it down from mid off and combines with Karthik to throw the ball back in. A couple of runs are taken.

Another edge but this one falls short and goes through. Going away, fuller outside off, Khawaja reaches out to it and gets a thick one behind. Goes through Kohli at second slip down to third man. One run to end the over.
Back of a length coming into the batsman, goes off the thigh pad on the off side as he attempts to work it across the line. A leg bye is collected.
Marginally ahead of a length, outside off, blocked down on the off side.

Edged and FOUR! Surprising that there's only one slip given how much Bhuvi is moving the ball around. Length ball around off, shapes away late with some extra bounce. Takes the outside edge of Finch's bat and flies to the right of the diving Rohit Sharma at first slip. A boundary results.

Four running runs! The outfield has become quite slow due to the rain. Finch plays this on the up as he hits it through the cover region. Jadeja chases it down, keeps it in but when he looks to release the throw, he realizes that he is about to lose balance and cross the rope. Hence, he under-arms it to Dinesh Karthik backing up but it is well over his head. The batsmen take that extra fourth. This is now Aaron Finch's highest score in this series.
Good thinking from Bhuvneshwar and India. To counter Finch staying out of his crease, Dhoni has come right up to the stumps. A length ball around off, Finch drives it to the cover fielder.
Angling away from the batsman, quite close to off, Khawaja is squared up a bit as he defends it down on the off side.
Cut hard but straight to Jadeja. Slight width available, a length ball, Usman connects well but can't get it wide of the fielder.
Much better. Keeps it on a length and on off, not giving the batsman any room this time. It's defensively pushed towards mid off.
FOUR! Width on offer and Khawaja puts this away easily. Too short outside off, the left-handed batsman stays on the back foot and flays it through point to find the fence.
Doesn't rise as much on this occasion. Back of a length delivery on off which keeps slightly low, Khawaja camps back to pull but is caught on the thigh pad.
Fired full outside off, angling away, Khawaja drives it straight to the man at point.
Finch walks down the track and offers the full face of his bat as he firmly blocks it down towards mid off.
On the fifth stump line, a length delivery from the bowler, left alone easily by the batsman.
Touch straight in line, worked off the pads on the leg side. No run taken.
Seaming away after landing around off, Finch plays it off the outer half square through point and comes back for the second.
Fullish in length on this occasion, comfortably kept out.
Finch is standing well outside of his crease here. This is smart thinking. Bhuvi pitches it on a length around off, the Australian captain comes half-forward and blocks before the ball can move much.
Shaping away once more, Usman plays at it loosely and gets beaten as a result.
Khawaja is watchful as he stays back inside the crease and meets it with the full face.
Using the angle away from him again as Shami bowls it outside off, draws Khawaja into the shot and almost induces the edge too. The Aussie no.3 needs to be careful here.
Late movement in the air for Shami. Keeps it on a length around off, moves away slightly and whiskers past the outside edge of Usman Khawaja's bat. Close call.
Angling across the left-hander, on a length, Khawaja shoulders arms to it.
Full and attacking the stumps, Finch plays it off the inner half behind square on the leg side. Gets a single for it.
Short of a good length on off, Khawaja stays behind the line and defends.
Usman Khawaja walks in at no.3.

OUT! Some extra bounce and that does Alex Carey in! Second single digit score in ODI cricket for the southpaw. Bhuvneshwar Kumar bowls it on a back of a length around off, from around the wicket, Carey rises and looks to defend, but the ball shoots off and takes the shoulder of the bat. Flies to Kohli at second slip, who's smartly standing a few steps inside anticipating it could fall short. He gets low, takes it and just falls forward.
Fraction straight in line again, worked away on the leg side for nothing.
Around the leg stump line once more, rapped on the pads yet again.
Cutting back in from a length, on middle and leg, the batsman is caught on the pads as he tries to flick it away.
Well played. Finch walks down the track to Bhuvi to negate the seam movement and flicks it neatly through mid-wicket. The placement is good enough to fetch him three runs.
Served outside the line of off stump, on a length once again, the batsman lets it be.
Full and wide outside off, Carey throws his bat at it but connects only with thin air.

Run out chance missed! Jadeja was a little put off there by Karthik at cover. Carey taps this in front of point and Finch takes off. Is sent back because Alex sees Jadeja's rocket arm prepping to fire. Jadeja misses, as Karthik ducks at the last moment and that might have hampered his aim. Had he hit though, Finch was gone by miles.
FOUR! Good shot. Carey gets his first boundary. Short ball outside off, the southpaw rocks back and drags the pull through mid-wicket along the turf. It's in the gap and away to the fence.
Hits the good length area, keeps it close to off, kept out from inside the crease this time.
Just ahead of a length around off, Carey comes half-forward and defends.
Mohammed Shami to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Edged but short! On the fourth stump line, Finch plays at it and gets an edge behind. It flies towards first slip but falls just short. Testing first over from Kumar comes to an end.
Outside off once more, makes it go away again, another leave from the batsman.

Big shout for a leg before, turned down. Height the issue and that's what saves Finch. Lucky him, because he doesn't pick this up at all. After keeping two outside and making them go away, Bhuvneshwar brings this one back in and Finch shoulders arms. Is rapped on the pads but he survives.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Finch covers the line and shoulders arms to it.
Ready to begin again. Finch will take strike with Bhuvi to continue his over. Here we go...
Update 1350 local - Good news! Play to resume at 1355 local time. No overs will be lost, as of now, and the break in between innings will be of 30 minutes.

So we've just got two balls in. The groundstaff rushes onto the field and covers the square quickly as it's raining down at a steady rate. PLAY HAS BEEN TEMPORARILY SUSPENDED DUE TO RAIN. The frustrating game continues.
Hurled well outside off, on a good length, Finch strides forward and leaves it alone.
First runs on the board for Carey and Australia. Length delivery around off, shaping away, the left-hander taps it down in front of point and takes a single.

We are ready to get underway. Alex Carey will take strike with Aaron Finch partnering him at the other end. Bhuvneshwar Kumar to take the first new ball for India. Two slips in place for him. Here we go...
RAIN DELAYS START. The drizzle is back but it is not looking too bad. We are expecting a start at 1.30 pm local (0230 GMT). Fingers crossed.

Australia captain, Aaron Finch, says they would have bowled first as well as there's a bit of moisture underneath the surface. States that Jason Behrendorff is out with a back strain for Billy Stanlake and Adam Zampa comes in for Nathan Lyon. Reckons that the wicket is on the slower side, it doesn't usually change much. Adds that he would have preferred to bowl first, but he doesn't mind batting either. Feels that it's been an exciting couple of weeks, good win in Sydney, had really good game in Adelaide, excited to go here too. States that he likes to bat at the MCG and wants to do well today too.

India captain, Virat Kohli, says it's pretty overcast and will be a stop-start day, so there will be a lack of momentum. Hence the idea behind bowling first. Adds that they've had a good tour Down Under, so wants to finish on a high. Continues saying that the situation demanded that he step up in the last game, so that's what he did. Informs there are three changes as Mohammed Siraj, Ambati Rayudu and Kuldeep Yadav make way for Vijay Shankar, Kedar Jadhav and Yuzvendra Chahal.
TOSS - Ready for the spin of the coin. Kohli calls Heads and it is a Head. INDIA ELECT TO CHASE.

WEATHER - The previous text sums up how the mood is gonna be today. Let us describe it in more detail. The forecast is not good, with rain expected till at least 10.30 am IST. Hopefully, we get a full game of cricket.

Yayyyy!!!!! The drizzle is abated and we have a start on time! It is heavily overcast and the predictions are there for a start-stop day and trust us, there is nothing worse than that. Australia vs India. A series decider. Rain has no part in it. Not even a bit. Hello and a wet welcome to the third and final ODI at the iconic Melbourne Cricket Ground.
